page: Amazon Web Services r8i.24xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs across 48 physical cores utilizing the x86_64 architecture with Intel Xeon 6975P-C processors running at 3.9 GHz. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPUs, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps.

Benchmark data highlights strong multi-core and memory performance. The instance achieved a top-tier rating in memory bandwidth read-only tests, reaching 7,675.4 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 384.5 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Multi-threaded processing is highly efficient, as evidenced by a top-tier bzip3 decompression speed of 657.04 GB/sec and a PassMark CPU score of 106,946.29. Additionally, the processor's advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions), contribute to top-tier performance in extended instructions, encryption, and physics simulations.

This instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads, database operations, and large-scale data processing. It demonstrates strong performance in database operations with a PassMark database score of 33,046.14 and a top-tier Redis SET throughput of 171.48 million operations per second. It also supports medium to large LLM inference, processing 70B model prompts at 41.54 tokens per second. However, the lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, and the absence of dedicated GPUs limits its suitability for heavy graphical or GPU-accelerated deep learning tasks.
